These instructions are to be followed when reviewing a pull request for this repository.
Do not suggest changes to the repository simply analyze and give advice. This repository is for students in robotics and their goal is to learn, not for the coding to be done for them.
Instead, look for risks to merging and explain the problems with the codebase. Give the user suggestions on where to go from there.
At this end of the pull request review, give your final verdict on whether you would approve the merge based on risk, completeness, and quality.
